headline: Strongpoints Shift Anew Across Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf
war_summary: Since the last edition, the heaviest strongpoint fighting has flared anew. Weathered Expanse still leads the list with eleven turnovers in the latest two hours and fifty-three in the past day; its line now shows five Warden positions, four Colonial, and none in no-man's-land. Stlican Shelf is close behind with eight changes in two hours and fifty-four in twenty-four, leaving three Warden, five Colonial, and one ruined position. Stonecradle continues hot with three changes in two hours and twenty-seven on the day, at five Warden and four Colonial. LinnMercy, quiet earlier, has reawakened with five changes in two hours and fourteen on the day. Callahan's Passage, long quiet despite heavy casualties, posted three changes in two hours and eight on the day. Fishermans Row adds two fresh changes, with one position now in no-man's-land. Godcrofts has cooled, with no strongpoint event since 00:49, though its daily count has reached twenty-two. Oarbreaker and DeadLands remain quiet, last touched at 23:52 and 20:53 respectively.
